frontFaq.q: Is this an ATS or recruiting tool?
frontFaq.a: No. These are prompts you copy into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Nothing runs on our servers.

frontFaq.q: Do I have to go through all 6 phases in order?
frontFaq.a: No. Start with the problem that hurts today (e.g. job ad or interview), then return to other prompts later.

frontFaq.q: Can I use just one or a few prompts?
frontFaq.a: Yes. Start with one problem (e.g. job ad or interview) and come back to the others later.

frontFaq.q: How long does each prompt take?
frontFaq.a: About 3–5 minutes to prepare and copy; the AI chat itself depends on your questions and answers.

buyerFaq.q: Can I share this guide with my recruiting team?
buyerFaq.a: Yes, within your organization. The Personal license covers your HR and hiring team. Do not post the PDF publicly or resell it. Department-wide redistribution outside your company requires permission — email info@promptanatomy.app.

buyerFaq.q: Can I send the Advanced team rollout emails to my panel?
buyerFaq.a: Yes — that's exactly what they're for. The 3 rollout email templates and the 4-week pilot timeline are written to be copied into your inbox or wiki for internal use under the Personal license. Don't forward the PDF itself publicly or repost it on the open web.

buyerFaq.q: Is the sample debrief transcript in the Advanced guide a real case?
buyerFaq.a: It's an anonymized composite from real HR debrief patterns—names and companies removed. Use it to train hiring managers on structured debriefs and score alignment.

buyerFaq.q: What if I lose the download email?
buyerFaq.a: Email info@promptanatomy.app from your purchase address and we will resend a fresh signed link. Links expire after 7 days; we re-issue on request.

buyerFaq.q: What if I am not satisfied?
buyerFaq.a: Reply to your Stripe receipt within 14 days for a no-questions refund. We revoke the download link after approval.
